name: Aijou Helper Sei Kaigo
source:
I kept buying Loto for a long time... and finally won the 1st prize of * million dollars!
However, I'm already 90 years old.
Having not much longer to live, I hired 2 helpers of the highest grade to color my life!

A pure and pretty girl in the school uniform for the dream of the adolescence
A matured and beautiful female doctor for the dream of the late mature stage

These are 2 different kinds of the ultimate service of ecstasy!

This is a story about the realistic sexual caring from the old man's point of view.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052990.html]DLsite English[/url]]
